gloss: following the road; along the road

definitions.gloss: following the road; along the road; as the road goes
definitions.explanation: Following the natural course of a road without turning off. Very common in giving and receiving directions.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}なりに{進|すす}んでください。
examples.english: Please go straight along the road.

examples.japanese: この{道|みち}を{道|みち}なりに{行|い}くと{駅|えき}に{着|つ}きます。
examples.english: If you follow this road, you'll reach the station.

examples.japanese: {信号|しんごう}を{過|す}ぎたら{道|みち}なりに{右|みぎ}にカーブして、{二|ふた}つ{目|め}の{角|かど}を{左|ひだり}に{曲|ま}がってください。
examples.english: After passing the traffic light, follow the road as it curves right, then turn left at the second corner.

notes:
USAGE:
{道|みち}なり combines {道|みち} (road) and なり (as it is, following). It is almost always used with the particle に ({道|みち}なりに) to mean "following the road." This is an essential expression for giving and understanding directions in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道|みち}なりに{進|すす}む (to proceed along the road)
- {道|みち}なりに{行|い}く (to go along the road)
- {道|みち}なりに{歩|ある}く (to walk along the road)

SIMILAR WORDS:
まっすぐ means straight ahead, while {道|みち}なり means following the road even if it curves. When a road curves, {道|みち}なりに means to follow the curve rather than going straight off the road.
